answers.core: An add-on would be a good solution but since Polygon2D is integrated in Godot in my opinion it would be only natural for a Polygon3D to be integrated too.
answers.workaround: I'm thinking of using Polygon2Ds for the sprites and then render them into a Sprite3D with a RenderTexture, you can understand it's not a great solution.

title: Add a Polygon3D node (equivalent to Polygon2D)
